info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Work Request Submissions API

params.name: orderBy
params.description: This parameter is used to order results by their createdAt, status, requestTitle, workRequestSubmissionID, and location property instead of the default ordering. each property can be flipped reverse by putting a minus before the property e.g. "-createdAt".

params.name: locationIDs
params.description: This parameter is used to only get work requests at a specific group of Locations. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of Location IDs.

params.name: columns
params.description: CSV of field names (letters only); forwarded upstream as array

items.docs:
Lists WR submissions

Return data description:

| **Property** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| workRequestSubmissionId | The unique identifier of the work request submission. |
| status | Pending, Approved or Rejected. |
| createdByUserId | The unique identifier of the user who created the work request submission. |
| createdAt | The date the work request submission was created. The timestamp is in the following format: YYYY-MM-DD (2025-07-02) HH:MM:SS (21:36:31) |
| updatedAt | The date the

Creates a new work request submission. The submission enters a pending state and must be approved or declined by a reviewer.

`locationID` and `dueDateUnit` are required. All other fields are optional.

params.name: workRequestSubmissionID
params.description: The ID of the work request submission to approve.

items.docs: Approves a pending work request submission, generating a task from it.

params.name: workRequestSubmissionID
params.description: The ID of the work request submission to decline.

items.docs:
Declines a pending work request submission.

Both `declineReason` and `additionalNotes` are optional strings.
